mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 76 degrees at Verona Community Park. If you are outside tonight, look for the International Space Station starting at 8:19 PM as it travels from over Mount Horeb toward the East Northeast and passes almost directly overhead. We expect an overnight low of 59 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has released several notices regarding the upcoming November general election, including information on types A, B, C, D, and E notices, as well as public testing details. Residents can find these documents on the city website to stay informed on the voting process.

Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, catch live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, the Dane County Farmers' Market takes place Saturday at the Capitol Square, and the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival arrives in Verona this Saturday.

The Verona Police Department released information regarding an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student. The report indicates that the incident occurred back in 2019 and was officially reported to the department on Sunday, August 30, leading to a recent arrest.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Dark Chocolate Decadence flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight.
